raw_text: Decode regularly spelled one-syllable words with a variety of spelling patterns (VC, CV, CVC, CVCe, VCC, CCVC, CVCC, CVVC, CCVCC), including high-frequency words.
competency_statement: Decode regularly spelled one-syllable words with various common spelling patterns, including high-frequency words.
observable_behaviors: Read aloud one-syllable words with VC, CV, CVC, CVCe, VCC, CCVC, CVCC, CVVC, and CCVCC spelling patterns.
Recognize and decode high-frequency one-syllable words.
Apply phonics knowledge to decode words both in isolation and in context.
skill_clauses: Decode regularly spelled one-syllable words with VC, CV, CVC, CVCe, VCC, CCVC, CVCC, CVVC, and CCVCC spelling patterns.
Include decoding of high-frequency one-syllable words.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify one-syllable words with specified spelling patterns when reading.
student_actions.oral_production: Read aloud one-syllable words with various spelling patterns.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Sort or sequence one-syllable words by their spelling patterns.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply phonics rules to decode one-syllable words with different spelling patterns.
student_actions.representation_modeling: Model decoding of one-syllable words with different spelling patterns.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how phonics patterns help decode one-syllable words.
